items.quote: And they made bells of pure gold, and put the bells between the pomegranates upon the hem of the robe, round about between the pomegranates
items.claim: Bells of pure gold were made and positioned between pomegranates on the hem of a robe
items.place: upon the hem of the robe, between the pomegranates

items.quote: A bell and a pomegranate, a bell and a pomegranate, round about the hem of the robe to minister in; as the LORD commanded Moses
items.claim: The bells and pomegranates alternated in pattern around the hem of the robe for ministerial use, as commanded by God to Moses
items.object: the pattern of bells and pomegranates
